title: federated-metrics-driven profile merging and deterministic release snapshot generation
author: Naomi Chen
body:
Motivation: onboarding has become noisy when multiple probe sources (regional telemetry, CI workload runs, and customer-supplied samples) produce slightly divergent performance profiles for the same model variant. This causes churn in autogenerated release notes and complicates rollouts when the registry chooses a single "canonical" profile by arbitrary precedence.

What this PR does: 1) Introduces a federated-profile-merger that consumes a set of performance profile snapshots from multiple probes and produces a composed profile with weighted statistics (p50/p95 token latency, throughput, memory footprint) and provenance links. We weight probes by signal quality heuristics (sample coverage, run stability, and recency) so the composed profile better reflects production-like conditions. 2) Adds a deterministic telemetry-hash (telemetry_fingerprint) computed from normalized probe summaries so the same set of inputs yields the same fingerprint independent of ordering; this enables idempotent onboard runs and safer CI. 3) Adds a release-snapshot generator that bundles composed profiles, a short changelog blurb, and a stability score into a compact artifact (release_snapshot.json) used by downstream release automation and the console. 4) Hooks the generator into the onboard pipeline and the model-intake web UI so reviewers can preview the composed profile and proposed release blurb before approving.

Implementation notes: - federation/merger.py: core merge algorithm, weighting heuristics, and provenance resolver. Includes unit tests that cover edge cases (single probe, tie weights, missing fields). - telemetry/fingerprint.py: canonical serializer + blake2b-based hash with version tag. - pipeline/hooks/release_snapshot.py: snapshot assembler and compact serializer used by registry APIs. - ui/onboard_preview: adds preview endpoint and small React component to show composed metrics and suggested blurb. - docs: onboarding guide updated with section on federated profiles and how weights are computed.

Compatibility: the composed profile schema is a non-breaking additive extension to existing profile payloads (we keep legacy fields and add composed_metrics and telemetry_fingerprint). Downstream consumers that don't understand composed_metrics will still read legacy baseline fields.

Checklist: - [x] merger algorithm and unit tests - [x] deterministic hashing and cross-order idempotency tests - [x] snapshot serializer and compact schema - [x] UI preview for reviewers - [x] docs and migration notes - [x] e2e smoke run against intake CI

Notes for reviewers: focus review on federation/merger.py for weighting heuristics and the canonicalization rules in telemetry/fingerprint.py. The weighting parameters are tunable via registry config; defaults are conservative. The UI change is intentionally lightweight — preview only (no edit-in-place).
commits: Initial merger algorithm and tests (naomi/merger) - 3 files
Add telemetry fingerprinting and canonical serializer - 2 files
Release snapshot assembler and API hook - 4 files
UI preview component and integration tests - 6 files
Docs and onboarding guide updates - 2 files
review_thread: Ava Martinez: Can you explain why recency weighs more than sample coverage by default? Feels risky for short-lived spikes.

Naomi Chen: Default weight favors stability first, recency second. The heuristic is stable_score * 0.6 + recency_score * 0.3 + coverage_score * 0.1. I added comments and a config flag under registry.federation.weights for teams to tune.
Samir Patel: Left minor nits in merger.py about edge-case handling when percentile arrays are different lengths.
Naomi Chen: Addressed both nits, added padding function and unit tests for percentile alignment.
Jordan Liu: Verified telemetry_fingerprint is stable across reorderings; approving once CI green.
Ava Martinez: Approved after reading docs and seeing e2e smoke run results.
release_notes: Added federated profile merging to produce composed performance profiles from multiple probes; deterministic telemetry_fingerprint created for idempotency; autogenerated release_snapshot artifacts for concise changelogs and release gating. Migration: backward compatible; consumers can opt into composed_metrics.
notes: This PR reduces churn in release notes by consolidating probe signals and makes onboarding reproducible across CI runs. Future work: expose a tuning UI for federation weights and add a 'rollback-sensitivity' signal to the snapshot.
security_considerations: No secret/sensitive data is serialized in release_snapshot; we strip raw traces and only keep aggregated metrics and provenance references.
hotfix_related_incident: SUP-1287 - customer reported inconsistent profile diffs across regions; this PR implements the mitigation and was validated against the incident's sample set.
